curriculumTitle: Natural Disasters: Science, Engineering, and Policy

parts.partSubtitle: Understanding the scientific principles behind natural hazards.

units.title: Introduction to Natural Disasters
units.coreIdea: Establishes foundational understanding of natural disaster types, causes, and impacts through scientific inquiry.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Recent Major Natural Disaster Event (Hurricane, Earthquake, or Wildfire).

parts.partSubtitle: Investigating earth-based disasters and their mitigation strategies.

units.title: Earthquakes and Seismic Hazards
units.coreIdea: Analyzes earthquake mechanisms, prediction methods, and engineering solutions for seismic safety.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Major Earthquake Event with Significant Infrastructure Damage.

units.title: Volcanic Eruptions
units.coreIdea: Examines volcanic processes, monitoring techniques, and community response strategies.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Recent Volcanic Eruption with Population Impact.

parts.partSubtitle: Exploring weather-related disasters and water-based catastrophes.

units.title: Hurricanes and Severe Weather
units.coreIdea: Investigates hurricane formation, tracking, and impacts on coastal communities.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Major Hurricane Making Landfall in Populated Area.

units.title: Floods and Drought
units.coreIdea: Analyzes hydrological extremes and their management through engineering and policy solutions.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Extreme Flooding Event or Severe Drought with Agricultural Impact.

units.title: Wildfires and Climate Change
units.coreIdea: Connects wildfire behavior to climate patterns and examines long-term mitigation strategies.
units.anchoringPhenomenon: Large-Scale Wildfire Event in Wildland-Urban Interface.

pedagogical_framework.role_rotation: Each unit cycles through Scientist → Engineer → Policymaker perspectives
pedagogical_framework.assessment_structure: Research Brief + Role-specific artifacts (Risk Report, Engineering Proposal, Policy Brief)

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Recent Major Natural Disaster Event
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Analyze a recent natural disaster through the lens of scientific investigation, engineering response, and policy implications to understand the multidisciplinary nature of disaster management.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Disaster timeline, damage assessment reports, emergency response data, and recovery statistics.

role_artifacts.scientist: Risk Assessment Report analyzing hazard mechanisms
role_artifacts.engineer: Mitigation Strategy Proposal for infrastructure protection

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Major Earthquake with Infrastructure Damage
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Use seismic data analysis to understand earthquake mechanisms, evaluate building performance, and develop comprehensive seismic safety policies.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Seismograph data, building damage assessments, geological survey maps, and emergency response timelines.

role_artifacts.scientist: Seismic Analysis Report with earthquake prediction assessment
role_artifacts.engineer: Seismic Retrofit Proposal for critical infrastructure

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Recent Volcanic Eruption with Population Impact
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Integrate volcanic monitoring data to assess eruption risks, design early warning systems, and create evacuation protocols for at-risk communities.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Volcanic monitoring data (seismic, gas, thermal), population density maps, historical eruption records.

role_artifacts.scientist: Volcanic Hazard Assessment with monitoring recommendations
role_artifacts.policymaker: Community Evacuation Plan and Risk Communication Strategy

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Major Hurricane Making Landfall
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Track hurricane development and impacts to design coastal protection systems and emergency management protocols for hurricane-prone regions.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Hurricane tracking data, storm surge measurements, wind speed records, and coastal damage assessments.

role_artifacts.scientist: Hurricane Forecast Analysis with uncertainty quantification
role_artifacts.policymaker: Hurricane Preparedness and Recovery Policy Framework

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Extreme Flooding or Severe Drought Event
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Analyze hydrological extremes to design water management systems and develop adaptive policies for changing precipitation patterns.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Stream flow data, precipitation records, reservoir levels, agricultural impact assessments.

role_artifacts.policymaker: Water Resource Allocation Policy during Extremes

anchoring_phenomenon.title: Large-Scale Wildfire in Wildland-Urban Interface
anchoring_phenomenon.problem_description: Connect wildfire behavior to climate patterns and develop integrated approaches for fire management in a changing climate.
anchoring_phenomenon.provided_data: Fire weather data, burn area statistics, climate projections, ecosystem monitoring data.

role_artifacts.policymaker: Climate Adaptation Strategy for Fire Management
